msg: I reached a score in the 700s. What worked for me was going for one side for a while til the numbers dropped to about 2 or 3 and then switching to the other side. I didn't spot any particular pattern, and sometimes I did change things up by alternating sides after each round, but this was less successful. Overall, I did stick to the right side more as the numbers there seemed to be higher more frequently but I'm not sure if this is a pattern every time. Sometimes there seem to be periods where there's higher numbers in both baskets, and periods where there's lower numbers in both at a time. It is also important that you respond within 1.5 seconds in terms of both choosing the side and clicking on the basket. Good luck!
